description: Set or reset the reverse DNS (PTR) hostname of one VPS IP. For an IPv6 prefix, pass ipv6Address to target any address of the /64 (omit = primary address). The hostname must already resolve to that IP (A record for IPv4, AAAA for IPv6), otherwise the change is refused (400 vserver_rdns_hostname_not_resolving). Requires confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

hostname.description: New PTR hostname (must resolve to the IP); empty or null resets it to the default.

ipAddressId.description: IPv4 entry from get_vserver_reverse_dns (`ipAddressId`). Pass this or ipv6PrefixAllocationId.

ipv6Address.description: Only with ipv6PrefixAllocationId: the address of the /64 the PTR is for (full address or `::<suffix>`). Omit for the primary address.

serviceId.description: ID of the VPS: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_vservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: update_vserver_reverse_dns
title: Update VPS Reverse DNS
